field.label: Custom Rules
field.help: One rule per line: TYPE,PAYLOAD,TARGET (optionally suffixed with ,no-resolve for IP-CIDR, IP-CIDR6 and GEOIP). Allowed types: DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, IP-CIDR, IP-CIDR6, GEOIP, GEOSITE, DST-PORT. Targets: DIRECT, REJECT, REJECT-DROP or a proxy-group name from the template. Limits: 200 lines / 32768 bytes.
